newsitem.title: UK: UK's ECC to delist shares from NYSE.
newsitem.headline: UK's ECC to delist shares from NYSE.

text.p: English China Clays Plc said on Friday it had applied to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) to deregister its ordinary shares because of costs and the small numbers of shareholders in the U.S.
ECC said the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) would apply to the SEC to delist its American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) because of the small number of U.S. shareholders.

ECC said the ADRs outstanding represented less than one percent of its issued ordinary share capital. ECC said the costs of complying with SEC filing and reporting obligations and maintaining its NYSE listing and depositary facility outweighed the benefits.
ECC said the listing of its shares on the London Stock Exchange would not be affected by its decision.
